newsitem.title: UK: UK Channel 5 in movie deal with Warner Bros.
newsitem.headline: UK Channel 5 in movie deal with Warner Bros.

text.p: Britain's new terrestrial television broadcaster Channel 5 said on Wednesday it had signed a movie broadcasting deal with Time Warner Inc's Warner Brothers.
Channel 5 said the two-year output deal covered all Warner Bros feature films released in 1997 and 1998 in the U.S. and 190 titles from the U.S. company's library.
Channel 5 said the library included "Batman", "Presumed Innocent" and "Rebel Without A Cause", among others.
The company said the deal was the largest single terrestrial transaction in Britain concluded by Warner Bros. The company gave no financial details of the deal.
Channel 5, which launched at the end of March, is the first new commercial terrestrial television station in Britain since 1982. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4017
